messages:
sre-oncall: Holding the 09:00 UTC release slot due to an ongoing incident in EU edge (INC-64321). Canary rollout aborted. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Release slot 2026-03-21T09:00 UTC has been held by sre-oncall. Canary jobs cancelled and owners notified.
eng-release: Acknowledged. Any idea on scope and ETA?
kevin: Were seeing ~30s TTL divergence for KV prefixes between eu-west and eu-central resulting in stale reads for a subset of traffic. Tracing now.
maria: If stale embeddings are returned, reranking could be incorrect. I recommend pinning traffic to last known-good model hash in EU until fixed.
product-ops: Agree. Pause any release notes publication and external comms until we confirm impact.
ops-lead: Operational plan proposal: rollback EU zones to pinned v2026-03-19-2, run cache flush, then smoke validate. If green, schedule a staggered requeue +2h with zone gating.
alice: Revert is safer than a hotfix since we cannot guarantee immediate invalidation otherwise.
kevin: I will run the rollback: kubectl -n orbit rollout undo deploy/edge-inference --to-revision=42. After that trigger cache flusher: kubectl -n orbit exec cache-flusher -- /app/flush-prefixes --regions=eu-*.
pm-anna: Who will own the rollback? We need a short checklist so deploy-bot doesn't auto-resume.
sre-oncall: Kevin owns rollback, ops-lead runs smoke tests. I will keep the incident channel open and approve resume manually.
eng-release: deploy-bot, disable auto-resume on this slot until sre-oncall /approve-resume.
deploy-bot: Auto-resume disabled. Manual approval required.
product-ops: Proposed timeline: rollback now, 30m smoke. If green, requeue staggered at +2h. If failing, reschedule to tomorrow morning and escalate.
kevin: Rollback started. ETA ~10m for undo to complete.
sre-oncall: Add brief note to release draft: "Delayed due to EU KV cache divergence; rescheduling pending validation." Full RCA will follow.
alice: Adding ops note to release doc and holding #customers-notify draft.
eng-release: Confirm do NOT merge release notes or run notify workflow until I mark safe.
product-ops: Holding blog/email. pm-anna to update stakeholders after validation.
pm-anna: Will ping legal/comms once we have smoke pass.
sre-oncall: Will post a status update in +15m or earlier if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
